description: This file defines logging-related functions, classes, and macros for the Thunder project, including a template class for logging categories, external functions for dumping exceptions and system files, and macros for logging control.

classes.name: BaseLoggingType
classes.description: A template class for logging categories, providing static methods to control logging behavior and access metadata.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: External function to dump exception details based on exception type.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: External function to dump system files for a given process ID.

methods.name: BaseLoggingType::Announce
methods.description: Static method to announce or enable logging.

methods.name: BaseLoggingType::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the control for the logging category.

methods.name: BaseLoggingType::IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled for the category.

methods.name: BaseLoggingType::Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables logging for the category.

methods.name: BaseLoggingType::Metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the logging category.
